description: Display names for Lithuania hydrology polygons (OBJECTID in lt_subbasins.json). Overrides PAVADINIMA when missing or '-' -- the 6 missing-PAVADINIMA polygons (676, 678, 681, 683, 687, 689) were verified against real-world landmarks (point-in-polygon: Skuodas, Vistytis, Zarasai, Mazeikiai, Klaipeda/Palanga) since an earlier pass had several of these mislabeled. displayOrderByObjectId follows the official basin table order (Nemunas…Prieglius) as best matched to that earlier (now-corrected) labeling; two Šventosios polygons after Žeimenos.
